title: A fair measure helps release outworn forms

captions.energy: Joining capacities at a suitable pace

meaning: A proportionate shared rhythm can inspire fair actions and relief as an exhausted arrangement comes to an end.
text: Sometimes shared purpose becomes clearer when an unnecessary burden reaches completion. Temperance in the energy of Sahasrara supports a wish to relate different capacities and find a suitable pace of participation. Justice in the physical position describes shared actions: clarifying obligations, distributing what remains fairly and considering consequences. Death in emotions brings relief as space becomes available. Ending an exhausted part can feel rewarding because something useful continues without an obligation to carry everything that once belonged to its familiar format. You can recognise purpose in the simpler arrangement that becomes possible through a considered completion.

For example, you help a library end its paper delivery of event notices while retaining a visitors’ display. Together, you agree which promised notices will still be delivered, whose materials will be returned and when changes will be announced. **A fair measure makes completion accessible to everyone involved.** The last delivery ends without rushing or unspoken expectations. Relief concerns information remaining available while released time no longer belongs to maintaining the earlier distribution method.

The difficulty may arise if every remaining step demands fresh proof of equal contributions. Calm completion stretches into endless negotiation of small differences. A connecting motive and sense of release remain supportive. Actions benefit from proportion within the agreement itself: important promises stay definite without accounting becoming an additional obligation larger than the work being completed.
